fact: Al-Watwan reports that Komori TTS, the first Shikomori text-to-speech application, was launched on 28 July 2026 by a Comorian graduate now studying in Morocco, with no such model existing before.

A CNDRS researcher presented two AI early-warning models for Comorian conditions, one for juvenile delinquency and one for Karthala seismovolcanic changes, simulated on real data and not deployed, per La Gazette des Comores.

Comores Infos reports that the startup Komor-IA, founded in August 2025 by Soilahoudine Mohamed Ali, is developing three AI projects: Press-IA, Agro-IA (plant disease detection) and Health-IA (a breast-cancer diagnosis prototype claimed at 85% precision).

Komor-IA published KomoriTTS, a beta text-to-speech model for Shikomori (Shingazidja dialect) trained on its community voice corpus, and Al-watwan wrote about it on 4 August 2026, per Komor-IA's LinkedIn post.

Komor-IA, a Comorian AI initiative, released version 1.0 of the French-shiKomori Parallel Dataset on Hugging Face, with 1,424 French-Shingazidja sentence pairs contributed by Comorian volunteers, under gated access.
